start.description: Start date selected in the filter panel for plotting the values.

end.description: End date selected in the filter panel for plotting the values.

interval.description: The {@link Interval} selected in the filter panel.

project.description: The {@link ReliabilityMl.Project} selected in the filter panel.

assets.description: The {@link ReliabilityAsset}s selected in the filter panel.

modelOutputs.description: The model-outputs selected in filter panel which will be plotted as sepaarate lines on the chart.

showAlerts.description: Setting this as true will render the charts with alerts plotted.

showUnplannedEvents.description: Setting this as true will render the charts with unplanned events plotted.

showWorkOrders.description: Setting this as true will render the charts with work orders plotted.

showFeatureContributions.description: Setting this as true will show the feature contribution->modelOutput mapping on chart if field set to `true`.

assetToFeatures.description: Selected features to be plotted per asset. The keys of the map are asset IDs, and the values are arrays of feature names for that asset.

featureSpecificOutputs.description:
Will show the {@link ReliabilityMl.PredictionHeader} data corresponding to a mix from selected features and the
selected featureSpecificOutputs according to start, end, and interval

sensors.description: List of selected sensors in the filter panel.

metrics.description: Will plot the metric according to start, end and interval

title:
Spec for plotting the charts on the Analysis Detail page.

This spec will be populated using the values selected in the Reliability.AnalysisFilterPanel
and sent to the charting API.
name: AnalysisPageFilterPanelSpec
